name: Kindle Road & Ember Spa
summary: Traverse the scenic coastal waterway of Kindle Road heading north toward the volcano. Battle martial artists and swimmers along the sandy shores. Enter Ember Spa to relax in the thermal hot springs for complete party restoration, grab TM121 Scald, and retrieve a Fire Stone submerged in the baths.
